$comment: Deploy inputs wrangler.jsonc cannot hold, read by scripts/release/manifest-lib.ts (the release manifest, ADR 0160) and scripts/deploy.mjs. `features.ai`: Workers AI and Vectorize (the automation events consumer embeds changed records), remote-only so left out of wrangler.jsonc (ADR 0156); turned off with COS_AI=off or `create-composable-os --ai off`. The cos-records index is described in apps/app/deploy-inputs.json. `devOnly.services`: service bindings for local development and tests, never deployed; GATEKEEPER_FAKE binds cos-runner to itself, a target that does not exist yet on a first deploy.

secrets.name: TURNSTILE_SECRET_KEY
secrets.description: Optional. Cloudflare Turnstile's secret key (stage 29, ADR 0722): forms check a visitor's spam token with it, and without it take no answers from people who are not signed in. Set by a person (docs/deploying.md, Forms: Turnstile); never stored in D1.
